messages:
Maya Patel: quick design pass on the routing rules editor after running the preview sim. found several UX/accessibility issues and some unclear copy.
Liam Chen: ok send the list, I can triage now :+1:
Maya Patel: 1) Terminology mix: some places say 'Order' and others say 'Priority' for the same concept. Causes confusion in tooltip and API docs.
Samir Rao: consistent naming is key. backend uses 'priority' so let's prefer that everywhere.
Eva Gomez: agree. also the preview header currently says 'Playback' which product testers misread. suggest 'Preview simulation' or simply 'Simulation'.
Maya Patel: 2) Validation messaging is too vague. We show "Rule conflict detected" with no guidance. Need actionable message that references the conflicting rule and suggests fixes.
Liam Chen: propose: "Conflict with rule #3 — same condition overlap. Click to view or reorder." + link to open conflicting rule.
Samir Rao: add an inline anchor [Open rule #3] that focuses the rule in the drawer.
Maya Patel: 3) Keyboard reordering is broken. Tab skips the drag handle and users can't move rules via keyboard.
Liam Chen: fix: expose reorder as a focusable button with aria-label="Move rule"; when activated allow arrow keys to shift position; update aria-live for position changes.
DesignBot: accessibility-check: recommend role="button", aria-grabbed, and announce "Rule X moved to position Y" via aria-live polite.
Eva Gomez: 4) Contrast: the small status badge (12px) on gray-300 fails AA. Options: bolder font, darker color, or larger size.
Samir Rao: also propose adding an icon with aria-hidden to visually reinforce state, but keep text for screen readers.
Maya Patel: 5) Preview panel: when toggling 'simulate caching' PM needs to see batch size and estimated latency. currently only token/time is shown.
Liam Chen: add compact stats row: "Batch: 8 | Est latency: 120ms | Cache hit: 32%" and make it visible when any simulation toggles are on.
Maya Patel: copy updates: button "Save rules" -> "Save and apply"; rule tooltip -> "Applied at request routing time; affects selected model and region."
Samir Rao: hover/focus visual is subtle. bump elevation + 2px border in focus state; send Figma mock.
Eva Gomez: validation modal currently blocks and shows only one error. For multiple failures show a summary at the top and inline anchors to each problematic rule.
Liam Chen: validator returns array of {ruleId, message, severity}. UI should render summary with links that scroll/focus each card.
Maya Patel: action items: Liam - keyboard reorder + preview stats (owner). Samir - contrast and hover visuals (owner). Eva - copy changes and validation UX copy (owner). Maya - draft detailed validation strings and link behavior.
Samir Rao: I'll upload Figma frames in ~30m.
Liam Chen: I'll add unit + e2e for keyboard reorder and snapshot the preview stats row.
DesignBot: visual-regression: queued snapshot capture for rules-panel-reorder-v1.
Maya Patel: aim for small patch for beta release next Wed. can everyone ack? :calendar:
Liam Chen: ack
Samir Rao: ack
Eva Gomez: ack
Maya Patel: thanks all :heart:
